name: Above the Haze
source:
Above the Haze is a narrative experience about addiction, happiness, existentialism, and the meaning of life, set inside a bar in the middle of a rapidly decaying world.

You play as a bartender who serves drinks and substances hidden beneath the counter. What you choose to give each customer can significantly impact both their life and yours. Guide some toward happiness, push others deeper into dependency, help a few discover clarity, or simply ruin the rest of their day.

Watch how your actions affect the world around you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4967690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《迷雾之上》（Above the Haze）是一部探讨成瘾、幸福、存在主义与生命意义的叙事体验作品，舞台设定在一个急速腐朽破败的世界中央的一间小酒吧里。

你将扮演一名调酒师，为客人们递上美酒以及藏在吧台底下的违禁药物。你决定端给每位顾客的东西，都将深刻改变他们乃至你自己的人生轨迹：引领一部分人走向幸福，将另一部分人推入更深的依赖泥潭，帮寥寥数人寻获清醒顿悟，又或者干脆毁掉他们这一整天剩下的好心情。

静静见证你的一言一行如何重塑周遭的世界吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4967690/]Steam[/url]]
